chunkswap.config.title: ChunkSwap settings
chunkswap.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole effect on or off.
chunkswap.config.mode.tooltip: What area turns into the broken block.
chunkswap.config.radius.tooltip: Size of the area for the Sphere and Cube modes, in blocks.
chunkswap.config.thickness.tooltip: How many layers are swapped in the Chunk layer mode.
chunkswap.config.random.tooltip: The area turns into a random block instead of the broken one.
chunkswap.config.chance.tooltip: Chance that a broken block triggers the effect.
chunkswap.config.speed.tooltip: More is faster but can cause lag. Less is smoother but slower.
